about_the_game:
Own your very own RAT FARM in this surreal horror farming experience.

BREED

Breed your simulated rats with one another, mix their genetics and see what happens. Every rat is unique and so are their children, there are endless combinations of genes to explore. Splice the genes of rats using the laboratory and implant the embryos into surrogates, your imagination is the limit for whatever rat you want to build.

PROFIT

Every rat has its value, watch their genes and selectively breed the most profitable rats to adapt to the ever changing market. Every gene you add is another dollar made, and every value increased is more profit in your pocket

EXPLORE

With several explorable areas to find and sell your rats in, you'll never run out of activities. Visit the town to enlist your rat in a fight, race, or upgrade your gear, take a nice relaxing trip to the pond to fish out artifacts and aquatic rats, or venture into the sewer to find unique rats you can breed into your gene pool, just be careful with what you find.

BUILD

Expand your farm to fit your needs, build new pens, places to grow, or even just decorate, make this land your own with the expansive online catalogue of items, or upgrade your rats living conditions and even automate their production.

APPEASE

The Rat King has big plans for you, meet him in the caverns of the sewers and heed his words to be rewarded greatly.

GROW

Grow, water, and harvest new variants of cheese to feed your rats, their effects mutating their very DNA, each variant of cheese has it's own effects that change how your rats breed.

content_descriptors.notes: You can beat up creatures with a bat and eat rats when you're a VERY hungry fella.
